comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This port's development is tied to a three-part point system: Culture (Adventure), Commerce (Trade), and Armanent (Battle). Donating certain items help add to these points, raising its development in that field.

These deliveries must be done continuously in order to raise/maintain the port's development to a certain point as the server recalculates the three fields every Monday; Central Capital is the maximum and ideal state which yields the maximum amount of benefits. Borrowing from Stinker's old NetMarble guide, the best contribution items are:

Commerce
jewelled turbans
yellow and red gem books (about 5 times as many points as turbans)
clothier and harlequin books (about 3 times as many points as gem books)

Armament
large extra spankers
silver-plated armours (about 5 times as many points as spankers)

Culture
Danu figureheads

I'm sure there's a guide on this on the forums or something. Just leaving this here in case it can help people who peek in the comments. Cheers.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
I just want to clarify that Ternate does not accept Large Extra Spankers, nor Large Extra Sprit. For alternative, try Large Sterncastle. It has same points as that.

For culture, In case none of your character have high Search rank. You can consider making figurehead "Venus" and while it doesn't give as much points as Danu, but it's still reliable and faster to create, in case you don't want to wait half-day searching in same spot for Danu.
